Subject: Re: VennEra onboarding docs — W-9, bank letter, entity details

Sara — thanks for the package and the clear summary. A few quick clarifying questions so we can proceed with creating the vendor master record and set up PO routing: 

1) Can you confirm whether "VennEra Solutions, Inc." is the name you want on POs and invoices (i.e., legal name vs DBA)?
2) The bank letter looks good; will your bank provide an ABA/routing + account number on an official letter, or would you prefer to provide a voided check / ACH authorization with account details filled in?
3) Does the remittance address for invoices differ for tax- or legal notices (sometimes customers put a separate legal mailing address)?
4) Please confirm the signatory for contract acceptance (name + title) so we can populate the record.

Next steps from our side: once we have the ACH form (with account holder name and last 4 digits) and confirmation on the legal name for PO placement, Finance will assign a vendor ID and we'll share the vendor profile and PO routing instructions. Vanessa will handle the vendor creation in Coupa (or Workday depending on the account); Marissa will confirm tax classification for the ledger.

If you prefer a short call to close these items, I'm available today 2–4pm PT.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

3) Remit address is the same as the legal address provided earlier — there is no separate tax mailing address.
4) Contract signatory: Tomasz Kowalski, CFO, VennEra Solutions, Inc.
